prompt: Add 1 equivalent HBr to 1,3-butadiene at -78 °C. Draw the MAJOR product.

traps.note: The 1,4-product (1-bromo-2-butene) is the thermodynamic product (internal alkene, higher temp). At -78 °C the 1,2-product wins kinetically.

explanation: At -78 °C the allyl cation is trapped at whichever end is closer and lower-energy TS → 1,2-addition dominates (kinetic). Warm it up or reach equilibrium and the more-substituted internal alkene (1,4-product) wins thermodynamically.
